# f5xc_workload_flavor (Resource)

Workload Flavor Object Workload flavor is used to assign CPU, memory, and storage resources to workloads.

To get more information about f5xc_workload_flavor, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/workload-flavor)
